activities.activity: Sleeping through the night, fan running to cope with the warm conditions
Waking up, using the toilet and taking a cool shower, brushing teeth and washing up
Making and eating breakfast (toast with the toaster, fruit, iced water) and boiling the kettle for tea
Changing into light work clothes, packing a bag with a water bottle, hat and sunscreen, and checking phone messages
Commuting to the nonprofit office by walking and public transport, taking shade breaks in the heat
Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering calls and emails, and meeting with partner organisations
Taking a lunch break, eating a packed meal in a cool indoor spot and drinking plenty of water
Continuing office work: finalising the weekend community event plan, drafting schedules and updating program records on the computer
Commuting home from the office by public transport and walking, avoiding the hottest part of the day where possible
Taking a cool shower and changing into light house clothes after the hot commute
Cooking and eating dinner using the induction cooker, then leaving the range hood running while cooking
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on to stay cool
Clearing the table, loading the dishwasher and preparing iced tea and tomorrow's lunch supplies
Sitting at the desk with the desk lamp on, using the computer to review community program emails and volunteer rosters
Night-time wash: brushing teeth, washing face and getting ready for bed
Winding down in bed, checking the phone and setting an alarm for tomorrow
Sleeping, with the fan on and the door ajar to keep the room ventilated
